journeys.description: Start at Flutter login. Choose a family to explore screen-by-screen navigation. Each detailed journey states its own entry and conditions.

journeys.title: Flutter login and sign-in choices
journeys.description: The current app starts at Flutter login. Native login is obsolete and excluded from active journeys.
notes: LoginCoordinator includes a Flutter SplashScreen readiness screen before MainLoginScreen. Native LoginViewController / LoginActivity source fallbacks are obsolete per product instruction.

notes: The initial registration branch uses MOE for NER; renewal RegistrationOptionsView uses NER. These backend option codes are preserved separately.

notes: Identity scanning and SDK capture are platform capabilities. Manual registration screen branches remain native UI; native login is excluded.

iOS BAU registration, identity documents and status
notes: Swift coordinators instantiate the owning storyboard controllers. Guard failures leave the current screen unchanged. UAE PASS / EFR capture and remote/native vendor content require device verification.

journeys.title: Which tabs and dashboards does this user see?
journeys.description: Backend profile menus, active prepaid account, login type and role independently select the shell.
notes: The error shell contains only Home, Support and More. It still builds HomeTab for quick access, so prepaid Home may appear. No permission for Pay/Shop/Manage is inferred from failure.

journeys.title: Business Home, company accounts and account dashboards
notes: Overview, contract, subscriptions and billing are Flutter tabs inside AccountCoreScreen, not independent native dashboards. Backend-loaded company/account eligibility remains authoritative.

Native bills, summary bills and payment history
notes: Native billing also uses fragments/list row handlers. Missing direct screen-to-screen constructor references are not invented here; the inventory preserves caller evidence for those intermediate components.

journeys.title: Auto Pay setup, management and provider results

notes: Android completion explicitly opens EasyPrepaidMainActivity, the native prepaid Home. It does not automatically return to Flutter PrepaidHomeScreen.

In-app campaign visibility is fetched per current screen/login type. A missing or ineligible campaign yields no popup; its absence is not a navigation failure.

journeys.description: Alternate entry routes are attached to the same business screens; authentication/config/payload checks remain explicit.
notes: Non-migrated order-management URL currently delegates to native and selects Support; OrdersListingCoordinator call is commented out. Notification order tracking instead uses Flutter Orders when the new dashboard is enabled.
Shop mobile-plan URL still delegates native (the Flutter list is commented out). Home/Shop/Manage link handlers also select existing tabs; they do not imply a new screen push.

Native login in legacy DeeeplinkHolder guards is obsolete for this diagram root and is excluded; Flutter MainLoginScreen handles active login. Cold-start/host plumbing is a service boundary, not a second login root.
